metric_definitions.eta_mae: Mean absolute error in minutes between the ETA shown at check-in and the simulated actual consultation start.
metric_definitions.eta_median_ae: Median absolute error, same pairing as eta_mae.
metric_definitions.eta_within_15: Share of patients whose ETA at check-in was within 15 minutes of the actual start.
metric_definitions.wait_after_checkin: Mean minutes between check-in and consultation start (physical waiting).
metric_definitions.eta_revisions: Mean number of times a patient's ETA changed by at least 1 minute while waiting.
metric_definitions.eta_revision_size: Mean absolute size in minutes of those ETA changes.
metric_definitions.throughput_per_hour: Consultations completed per hour from OPD opening to the last completion.
metric_definitions.no_shows: Mean patients per day who never arrived.
metric_definitions.skips: Mean skip actions per day (grace period ran out).
metric_definitions.reinsertions: Mean late arrivals reinserted after being skipped.
metric_definitions.notification_failures: Mean failed alert attempts per day.
metric_definitions.queue_order_violations: Times a patient was started while an earlier eligible patient waited. Should be 0.
